name: Protopasta c-Matte PLA @base
filament_notes:
c-Matte PLA (matte finish). Material Data Table: 200C up to 12 mm3/s, 220C up to 18 mm3/s, 45C plate. This profile uses 200C with an 18 mm3/s cap - raise toward 220C when printing near the cap. Density 1.3 g/cm3 per SDS.
Let the plate cool below 40C before removing prints.
